datasets.name: Site K-7 DEM (synthetic)
datasets.description: 512×512 Float32 DEM, procedurally generated — an excavation pit, a linear trench and a spike cluster are planted for the anomaly workbench. SYNTHETIC DATA: no real location is depicted.

metadata.note: Local-only datasets. GeoVault's clean-room policy (connect-src 'self') means it can never load remote data; every dataset ships with the app or is dropped in by the analyst.
